summary.text: Jim Shaw is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 32 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An entrepreneur who worked in oil and gas software, he advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jim Shaw was born in Oklahoma City, graduated from Putnam City High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2006.
His career experience includes working as a general manager and as president, chief operating officer and co-owner of a software and services company in oil and gas.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he began at Chesapeake Energy as an undergraduate intern, later became co-owner of Land Information Services, which he and his partner sold in 2022, and stepped away from the company in 2024.
Shaw assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Kevin Wallace, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Government Oversight Committee.

In the survey, he described the core of his campaign as "Land, Livelihoods and Legacies," including opposition to what he called the "green energy" agenda, and said he wants to protect the right of families to homeschool without government interference.
